name: ok_context_compressed
description: A compressed block is one appended event, not a rewrite of the log. The range names two records that are still there, so restoring the block is a read and the originals never depend on the summary surviving. Same envelope, same version: a v1 reader that does not know the type skips it and sees the uncompressed history, which is the safe degradation.
